title: 光纖陣列主動對準
summary: 以多軸光纖陣列搜尋、功率正規化與固定後漂移為主軸，完成 4 階段、24 項模型與判讀作業；包含定量算例、量測基準、失效區分與封裝交接。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 modeling/diagnostic work packages address Multiaxis fiber-array search, normalized power and post-attach drift, with quantitative examples, measurement references, failure discrimination and package handoff.
scope: 公開原理與可重算假想算例；不是代工廠配方、設備設定或產品合格界限。代表照片與概念圖不能當作每一步的實物製程影像。
scopeEn: Public principles and reproducible hypothetical examples, not foundry recipes, tool settings or product acceptance limits. Representative photos and concept diagrams are not images of each actual process operation.

steps.title: 定義光功率參考面：模型與設計
steps.titleEn: Define optical power reference planes: model and design
steps.objective: 建立定義光功率參考面的可驗證模型及適用邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a verifiable model and validity boundary for define optical power reference planes.
steps.instruction: 先標出「定義光功率參考面」的座標、光／電／熱輸入與輸出。輸出讀值同時含雷射、纖線、耦合與晶片路徑；搜尋目標須先正規化。 用至少兩個設計狀態比較本單元變數，寫出能被量測推翻的預測；在工作台依師傅示意判讀相關介面，保留假設與未知參數。
steps.instructionEn: Mark the coordinates and optical/electrical/thermal inputs and outputs for define optical power reference planes. Output includes source, fiber, coupling and chip paths; normalize the objective before searching. Compare at least two design states and write a prediction that measurement could falsify. Review the relevant interfaces with the mentor view and preserve assumptions and unknown parameters.
steps.observation: 使用分光參考同步記錄輸入與輸出，判別源漂移與耦合變化。
steps.observationEn: Record input reference and output together to separate source drift from coupling change.
steps.failure: 錯誤推論「輸出變亮一定表示位置更準」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
steps.failureEn: The incorrect inference "Higher output always means better position" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.
steps.check: 提交定義光功率參考面的變數表、兩種狀態與量測判別紀錄：使用分光參考同步記錄輸入與輸出，判別源漂移與耦合變化。 寫明剩餘不確定度與不支持的結論。
steps.checkEn: Submit variables, two states and a measurement-discrimination record for define optical power reference planes: Record input reference and output together to separate source drift from coupling change. State remaining uncertainty and unsupported conclusions.

knowledge.title: 機制與模型
knowledge.text: 輸出讀值同時含雷射、纖線、耦合與晶片路徑；搜尋目標須先正規化。
knowledge.textEn: Output includes source, fiber, coupling and chip paths; normalize the objective before searching.

knowledge.title: 量測如何區分解釋
knowledge.text: 使用分光參考同步記錄輸入與輸出，判別源漂移與耦合變化。 不可推成：輸出變亮一定表示位置更準
knowledge.textEn: Record input reference and output together to separate source drift from coupling change. Do not infer: Higher output always means better position

knowledge.title: 定量算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 假設兩個相同 Gaussian 模態的強度 1/e² 半徑 w=2 μm，橫向偏移 d=1 μm，η=exp[−(d/w)²]=0.7788，單一偏移損耗 1.086 dB。若 d 降到 0.5 μm，損耗為 0.271 dB；均未含角度、端面反射及模態尺寸差。 功率最大化不是幾何位置校準；雷射漂移、偏振、探測器飽和和多通道權重都可能改變搜尋結果。
knowledge.textEn: For identical Gaussian modes with 1/e² intensity radius w=2 μm and lateral offset d=1 μm, η=exp[−(d/w)²]=0.7788 and offset loss is 1.086 dB. Reducing d to 0.5 μm gives 0.271 dB, excluding angle, facet reflection and size mismatch. Power maximization is not geometric calibration; laser drift, polarization, detector saturation and channel weighting can alter the search.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「光纖陣列主動對準」的「定義光功率參考面：模型與設計」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出晶粒、基板、接點與量測端的介面，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「光引擎：把訊號接回來」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與批號、接合位置、熱歷史、接點讀值與顯微圖版本的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Define optical power reference planes: model and design” in “Active alignment of fiber arrays”. Draw the die, substrate, joint and measurement interfaces; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Optical Engine: Restore the Signal” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for lot, joint location, thermal history, contact readings and micrograph version, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

knowledge.title: 機制與模型
knowledge.text: 粗搜尋只需找到可靠光訊號，步距過大可能跨越窄峰而誤判無光。
knowledge.textEn: Coarse search finds a reliable signal; excessive spacing can skip a narrow peak.

knowledge.title: 量測如何區分解釋
knowledge.text: 比較兩種掃描間距與光訊號下限，記錄未捕獲區。 不可推成：找不到峰即代表晶片失效
knowledge.textEn: Compare two scan spacings and signal floors, recording uncaptured regions. Do not infer: Failure to find a peak proves chip failure

knowledge.title: 定量算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 假設兩個相同 Gaussian 模態的強度 1/e² 半徑 w=2 μm，橫向偏移 d=1 μm，η=exp[−(d/w)²]=0.7788，單一偏移損耗 1.086 dB。若 d 降到 0.5 μm，損耗為 0.271 dB；均未含角度、端面反射及模態尺寸差。 功率最大化不是幾何位置校準；雷射漂移、偏振、探測器飽和和多通道權重都可能改變搜尋結果。
knowledge.textEn: For identical Gaussian modes with 1/e² intensity radius w=2 μm and lateral offset d=1 μm, η=exp[−(d/w)²]=0.7788 and offset loss is 1.086 dB. Reducing d to 0.5 μm gives 0.271 dB, excluding angle, facet reflection and size mismatch. Power maximization is not geometric calibration; laser drift, polarization, detector saturation and channel weighting can alter the search.
